using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using System.Xml.Linq;
using Ferrule.Generated;
using Ferrule.Runtime;

static object Typed(FerruleInstance node) => node switch
{
    FerruleGroup group => new { kind = "group", fields = group.Fields.Select(field => new { name = field.Name, value = Typed(field.Value) }).ToArray() },
    FerruleRepeated repeated => new { kind = "repeated", items = repeated.Items.Select(Typed).ToArray() },
    FerruleScalar scalar => new { kind = scalar.Value.Kind.ToString(), value = scalar.Value.Kind switch {
        FerruleValueKind.Int64 => (object?)scalar.Value.Int64Value,
        FerruleValueKind.String => scalar.Value.StringValue,
        FerruleValueKind.Bool => scalar.Value.BooleanValue,
        _ => null,
    } },
    _ => throw new Exception("Unexpected mapped instance shape"),
};

static void Verify(FerruleInstance actual, JsonElement expected)
{
    switch (expected.ValueKind)
    {
        case JsonValueKind.Object:
            if (actual is not FerruleGroup group || group.Fields.Count != expected.EnumerateObject().Count()) throw new Exception("Whole group differs");
            foreach (var (actualField, expectedField) in group.Fields.Zip(expected.EnumerateObject()))
            {
                if (!StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(actualField.Name, expectedField.Name))
                    throw new Exception("Ordered typed output field differs");
                Verify(actualField.Value, expectedField.Value);
            }
            break;
        case JsonValueKind.Array:
            if (actual is not FerruleRepeated repeated || repeated.Items.Count != expected.GetArrayLength()) throw new Exception("Whole sequence differs");
            for (int index = 0; index < repeated.Items.Count; index++) Verify(repeated.Items[index], expected[index]);
            break;
        case JsonValueKind.Number:
            if (actual is not FerruleScalar number || number.Value.Kind != FerruleValueKind.Int64 || number.Value.Int64Value != expected.GetInt64()) throw new Exception("Integer count differs");
            break;
        case JsonValueKind.String:
            if (actual is not FerruleScalar text || text.Value.Kind != FerruleValueKind.String || text.Value.StringValue != expected.GetString()) throw new Exception("String differs");
            break;
        default: throw new Exception("Outside authored output domain");
    }
}

// XElement/XNode comparison reused from the frozen imported public host. Explicit
// normalization ignores only four ASCII layout characters between child elements.
static XElement XmlTree(XElement element)
{
    bool hasElements = element.Elements().Any();
    object Part(XNode node) => node switch
    {
        XElement child => XmlTree(child),
        XText text => new XText(text.Value),
        XComment comment => new XComment(comment.Value),
        XProcessingInstruction instruction => new XProcessingInstruction(instruction.Target, instruction.Data),
        _ => throw new Exception("Unexpected XML element-tree node"),
    };
    return new XElement(element.Name,
        element.Attributes().Where(attribute => !attribute.IsNamespaceDeclaration)
            .OrderBy(attribute => attribute.Name.NamespaceName, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .ThenBy(attribute => attribute.Name.LocalName, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .Select(attribute => new XAttribute(attribute.Name, attribute.Value)),
        element.Nodes().Where(node => !(hasElements && node is XText text &&
            text.Value.All(character => character is ' ' or '\t' or '\r' or '\n'))).Select(Part));
}

static void AssertXml(string actual, string expected)
{
    var actualRoot = XDocument.Parse(actual, LoadOptions.PreserveWhitespace).Root!;
    var expectedRoot = XDocument.Parse(expected, LoadOptions.PreserveWhitespace).Root!;
    if (!XNode.DeepEquals(XmlTree(actualRoot), XmlTree(expectedRoot)))
        throw new Exception("Complete schema-independent XML tree differs");
}

static void RejectOracle(Action action, string label)
{
    try { action(); }
    catch (Exception error) when (error.Message is "Ordered typed output field differs" or "Complete schema-independent XML tree differs")
    { return; }
    throw new Exception($"Oracle accepted {label}");
}

static void OracleControls()
{
    using var expected = JsonDocument.Parse("{\"Included\":0,\"Excluded\":0}");
    var included = new FerruleField("Included", new FerruleScalar(FerruleValue.FromInt64(0)));
    var excluded = new FerruleField("Excluded", new FerruleScalar(FerruleValue.FromInt64(0)));
    Verify(new FerruleGroup(new[] { included, excluded }), expected.RootElement);
    RejectOracle(() => Verify(new FerruleGroup(new[] { excluded, included }), expected.RootElement), "swapped equal-valued fields");
    const string compact = "<Results><Included>0</Included><Excluded>0</Excluded></Results>";
    AssertXml("<Results> \t\r\n<Included>0</Included>\n \t<Excluded>0</Excluded>\r\n</Results>", compact);
    foreach (string actual in new[] {
        "<Results><Excluded>0</Excluded><Included>0</Included></Results>",
        "<Results><Included>0</Included><Excluded>0</Excluded><Extra/></Results>",
        "<Results><Included>0</Included><Included>0</Included><Excluded>0</Excluded></Results>",
        "<Results><Included>0</Included>\u00a0<Excluded>0</Excluded></Results>",
        "<Results><Included>0</Included>\u2003<Excluded>0</Excluded></Results>",
    }) RejectOracle(() => AssertXml(actual, compact), "XML order/shape/Unicode character-data drift");
    AssertXml("<a:R xmlns:a='urn:r' a:k='v' z='1'><!--keep--><?guard ok?><a:A>v</a:A></a:R>",
              "<b:R xmlns:b='urn:r' z='1' b:k='v'><!--keep--><?guard ok?><b:A>v</b:A></b:R>");
    const string nodes = "<R marker='yes'><!--keep--><?guard ok?><A>v</A></R>";
    foreach (string actual in new[] {
        "<R marker='yes'><!--changed--><?guard ok?><A>v</A></R>",
        "<R marker='yes'><!--keep--><?guard changed?><A>v</A></R>",
        "<R marker='yes'><?guard ok?><!--keep--><A>v</A></R>",
        "<R marker='no'><!--keep--><?guard ok?><A>v</A></R>",
        "<R xmlns='urn:changed' marker='yes'><!--keep--><?guard ok?><A>v</A></R>",
    }) RejectOracle(() => AssertXml(actual, nodes), "expanded name/attribute/comment/PI drift");
    AssertXml("<R><A>\u00a0\u2003</A></R>", "<R><A>\u00a0\u2003</A></R>");
    RejectOracle(() => AssertXml("<R><A> </A></R>", "<R><A/></R>"), "meaningful leaf space");
    Console.Error.WriteLine("filtered-count oracle controls completed: ordered typed group and schema-independent XML");
}

static void Refuses(Action action, JsonElement test, string boundary)
{
    try { action(); }
#if FERRULE_XML_INPUT
    catch (FerruleXmlBoundaryException error)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, stage = "input", category = error.Kind.ToString(), error = error.ToString() }));
        if (error.Kind.ToString() != test.GetProperty("runtimeCategory").GetString()) throw new Exception("Wrong XML error category", error);
        return;
    }
#endif
#if FERRULE_X12_INPUT
    catch (FerruleX12Exception error)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, stage = "input", category = error.Error.ToString(), error = error.ToString() }));
        if (error.Error.ToString() != test.GetProperty("runtimeCategory").GetString()) throw new Exception("Wrong X12 error category", error);
        return;
    }
#endif
    throw new Exception("Invalid input reached mapping");
}

OracleControls();
string source = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "source-schema.json"));
string target = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "target-schema.json"));
string kind = File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "input-kind.txt"));
using var cases = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText(Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "cases.json")));
foreach (var test in cases.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
{
    string document = test.GetProperty("input").GetString()!;
    FerruleInstance Text() => kind switch {
#if FERRULE_XML_INPUT
        "xml" => FerruleXml.ParseStructuredEmbedded(source, document),
#endif
#if FERRULE_X12_INPUT
        "x12" => FerruleX12.ParseEmbedded(source, document),
#endif
        _ => throw new Exception("Unknown authored input cohort"),
    };
    FerruleInstance Bytes() => kind switch {
#if FERRULE_XML_INPUT
        "xml" => FerruleXml.ParseStructuredEmbeddedBytes(source, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(document)),
#endif
#if FERRULE_X12_INPUT
        "x12" => FerruleX12.ParseEmbeddedBytes(source, Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(document)),
#endif
        _ => throw new Exception("Unknown authored input cohort"),
    };
    if (test.TryGetProperty("reject", out var reject) && reject.GetBoolean())
    {
        if (test.GetProperty("stage").GetString() != "input") throw new Exception("Wrong expected error stage");
        Refuses(() => Text(), test, "text");
        Refuses(() => Bytes(), test, "utf8");
        continue;
    }
    foreach (var (boundary, input) in new[] { ("text", Text()), ("utf8", Bytes()) })
    {
        string before = JsonSerializer.Serialize(Typed(input));
        for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= 2; attempt++)
        {
            FerruleInstance output;
            try { output = GeneratedMapping.Execute(input); }
            catch (Exception error) { Console.Error.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, attempt, stage = "mapping", error = error.ToString() })); throw; }
            Console.Error.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, attempt, typed = Typed(output) }));
            string json = FerruleJson.SerializeEmbedded(target, output);
#if FERRULE_XML_INPUT
            string? xml = test.TryGetProperty("expectedXml", out var expectedXml)
                ? FerruleXml.SerializeDocumentEmbedded(target, output, true, false, null, null) : null;
#else
            // Only XML-input cohorts declare XML output literals.
            if (test.TryGetProperty("expectedXml", out _)) throw new Exception("XML output literal in a non-XML cohort");
            string? xml = null;
#endif
            Console.WriteLine(JsonSerializer.Serialize(new { name = test.GetProperty("name").GetString(), boundary, attempt, stage = "mapping", output = JsonNode.Parse(json), xml }));
            if (JsonSerializer.Serialize(Typed(input)) != before) throw new Exception("Caller input changed");
            Verify(output, test.GetProperty("expected"));
            if (!JsonNode.DeepEquals(JsonNode.Parse(json), JsonNode.Parse(test.GetProperty("expected").GetRawText()))) throw new Exception($"Whole output differs: {json}");
#if FERRULE_XML_INPUT
            if (xml is not null)
            {
                AssertXml(xml, expectedXml.GetString()!);
                var actualTree = FerruleXml.ParseStructuredEmbedded(target, xml);
                var expectedTree = FerruleXml.ParseStructuredEmbedded(target, expectedXml.GetString()!);
                if (JsonSerializer.Serialize(Typed(actualTree)) != JsonSerializer.Serialize(Typed(expectedTree)) ||
                    JsonSerializer.Serialize(Typed(actualTree)) != JsonSerializer.Serialize(Typed(output)))
                    throw new Exception("Complete literal XML tree differs");
            }
#endif
        }
    }
}
Console.WriteLine($"filtered-count {kind} Release cases: {cases.RootElement.GetArrayLength()}");
